brief.headline: Ask for ₹290.00/KG to match Shrinath — they are loss-making with weak financials, so pair the price ask with faster payment to help their cash

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹290.00/KG across all laminates — the price Shrinath Roto Pack already gives us
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹290.00/KG to Shrinath Roto Pack for the same items; GLS charges ₹295.00/KG. The market research shows ₹205–305/kg is fair for pharma ORS sachet laminate, with ₹250/kg typical — so ₹290 is well within the fair band and we have proof we can get it.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days (half our current 30 days) in exchange for the ₹5/kg price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster costs us ₹9.49 L of cash freed up, but they borrow money at about 10.96% so early payment is worth roughly that rate to them — a fair trade for the price cut

brief.financialLeverage: GLS is financially fragile: they lost ₹-23.68 Cr in FY2024-25, keep -3.4% profit (peers keep 2.5%), score 2/10 on money-health, owe 2.15x their own cash, and sit in the grey distress zone (Altman Z 1.68). They have severe legal cases, GST and EPF delays, and a BBB- credit rating. We are tiny to them — 0.33% of their ₹691.05 Cr revenue — so we have no volume leverage. Push gently: lead with supply security and lining up a second source (Huhtamaki or Constantia Parikh), offer faster payment to ease their cash crunch, and frame the price ask as matching what we already pay elsewhere. A hard squeeze could tip them over and leave us short of supply.

evidence.point: They keep far less profit than peers
Their money-health score is very weak
They sit in the distress grey zone
We are a tiny customer to them

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier — proven and scalable for laminate sachets; health C (58/100), revenue ₹2755.75 Cr

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India arm, specialises in pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong fit for our ORS sachets; revenue ₹222.04 Cr

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film and conversion — can second-source at scale; revenue ₹16492.00 Cr

risks: They are loss-making and financially fragile — pushing too hard on price could break them and leave us short of laminates; keep Huhtamaki or Constantia warm as backup
Severe legal cases, GST filing delays and EPF payment delays all on record — watch for operational or compliance disruption
We are only 0.33% of their business so we have no volume stick — the ask must rest on our own data (we pay ₹290 to Shrinath) and the threat of moving volume to a second source
Their credit rating is only BBB- and health score D (21/100) — do not increase our exposure; cap our annual buy with them and dual-source from day one
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying you ₹295 when Shrinath gives us ₹290 for the same laminate — let's close that gap, and in return we'll pay you in 15 days instead of 30 to help your cash flow.
